name: DirectoryCopy
description: Copies the contents of a directory to a destination directory.
syntax: DirectoryCopy( string source, string destination, [boolean recurse], [any filter], [boolean createPath] )

params.name: source
params.description: Pathname of directory from which you copy content.

params.name: destination
params.description: Path of the destination directory. If not an absolute path, it is relative to the source directory.

params.name: recurse
params.description: If true, copies the subdirectories, otherwise only the files in the source directory.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Filter to be used to filter the data copied:

- A string that uses "*" as a wildcard, for example, "*.cfm"
- An UDF (User defined Function) using the following pattern "functioname(String path):boolean", the function is run for every single file, if the function returns true, then the file is will be added to the list otherwise it will be omitted

params.name: createPath
params.description: if set to false, expects all parent directories to exist, true (default) will generate necessary directories
